title: CO₂ emissions
description: Annual carbon dioxide emissions by country and year — a large, real table, good for grouping, filtering and plotting a trend over time.

title: Life expectancy
description: Life expectancy at birth, in years, by country and year from 1950 to 2016. Three columns, so it is an easy first dataset to reason about.
source: Our World in Data, compiling Gapminder, the UN World Population Prospects and IHME

title: Pride and Prejudice (full text)
description: The whole novel as plain text — for counting words, measuring sentence length, or any other question you can ask of a large piece of writing.
code:
from pyodide.http import pyfetch

response = await pyfetch("../data/pride-and-prejudice.txt")
text = await response.string()
print(f"{len(text.split()):,} words")

title: CO₂ per person, by country
description: Emissions divided by population, so large and small countries can be compared fairly — the same measure, per person, everywhere.

title: Share of electricity from renewables
description: The percentage of each country's electricity that came from renewable sources, year by year — a good dataset for asking who changed fastest.

title: Population, by country and year
description: How many people lived in each country, year by year — most useful joined onto another dataset, to turn a total into a rate.
